name: The Valor Family
label: Quest
description: Sirra Von'Indi asks you to search Raven Hill for records of its lost people. Darkshire remembers their courage, but little of Raven Hill's history…
intro: Sirra Von'Indi asks you to search Raven Hill for records of its lost people. Darkshire remembers their courage, but little of Raven Hill's history remains in her library.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.
Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.
If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.
I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
